user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to surface them in ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Visits only landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training OpenAI's generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits pages when users ask questions or trigger GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by gathering public web data.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to exclude materials from model training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to individual user questions.
user_agents.scope: Supports user-directed web search and user queries in Claude AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent retrieval in response to user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to enhance search response relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent indexing content for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google's search indexes and performs general analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for Google Search and related products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shopping content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Fetches pages for Search testing and diagnostic tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites for various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls sites requested by owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training and grounding use for Gemini models and apps.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and indexing for Perplexity search.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage via robots.txt rules.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web crawling and indexing for Perplexity search.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage via robots.txt rules.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers Apple search features and gathers data for Apple ecosystem.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Allows publishers to control use of content for generative AI training.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl; controls training usage of data crawled by Applebot.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, and cite sources in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls online content for advertising and other business use cases.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to train foundation AI models and improve products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls online content directly for training AI models or improving products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at a user's request for agentic AI tasks.
user_agents.scope: Evaluates and improves agentic AI capabilities, including website navigation for user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Bing search indexing and AI grounding features.
user_agents.scope: Bing search index and grounding data for Microsoft AI experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Microsoft-Copilot
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to ground answers in Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Microsoft Copilot queries and AI-assisted responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Microsoft-Copilot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for product improvements and training Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences across Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or via other search bot directives.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to answer user-initiated actions and queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web information; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Fetches a randomly selected sample subset of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
